Hymn 48: Glorious Things Are Sung of Zion
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major

This is hymn number 48 titled "Glorious Things Are Sung of Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by A. Laurence Lyon and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
